name: ChangeApprovalRiskAssessor
tagline: The Change Approval Risk Assessor turns a change request (RFC) into a short guided form.
description: The Change Approval Risk Assessor turns a change request (RFC) into a short guided form. While the requester types, it works out how risky the change is (a score from 0 to 100: Low, Medium or High), checks the schedule (notice period, change freeze, business hours) and shows exactly who has to approve it - from a pre-approved standard change up to the Change Advisory Board (CAB) or the emergency board (ECAB).
features: Affected services with tiers and owners, implementation window
Weighted risk questionnaire plus automatic risk factors (tier-1 services, business hours, downtime, users affected, change freeze, emergency) giving a live 0-100 risk score and level
Plans and evidence required by risk
Schedule checks (notice period, freeze periods, business hours) and the approval route it needs (pre-approved standard change, line manager, change manager, service owners, CAB or emergency CAB)
Stores the whole assessment (with a readable summary) as JSON in one text column
